theorem add_one_times_at_most (a b : ℕ) : a * b + 1 ≤ (a + 1) * (b + 1) :=
begin
  -- Expand the product on the right-hand side of the inequality
  calc
    (a + 1) * (b + 1) = (a + 1) * b + (a + 1) * 1
      : by ring
  ... = a * b + a * 1 + 1 * b + 1 * 1
      : by ring
  ... = a * b + a + b + 1
      : by ring
  ... = (a * b + 1) + a + b
      : by ring
  ... = (a * b + 1) + (a + b)
      : by ring
  ... = a * b + 1 + (a + b)
      : by ring
  ... ≤ a * b + 1 + (a + b)
      : by omega
  ... = a * b + 1 + a + b
      : by ring
  ... = a * b + 1 + (a + b)
      : by ring
  ... = a * b + 1 + (b + a)
      : by ring
  ... = a * b + 1 + b + a
      : by ring
  ... = a * b + 1 + a + b
      : by ring
  ... = a * b + 1 + (a * b + 1)
      : by ring
  ... ≤ a * b + 1
      : by omega
end
